AR342
Built Heritage
0.5 Credit
Archaeologists working in urban areas with built landscapes require specialized knowledge to excavate, record and conserve these heritage resources. A survey of techniques for documenting standing architecture provides a background for this fundamental aspect of archaeological investigation. Methods of studying and recording this type of built heritage' as required by modern heritage legislation are also introduced. The
course
includes experiential learning and analysis of local case studies in the Kitchener-Waterloo region.
